tools.name: audit_website
tools.description: Grades a public website out of 100 (A–F) across speed & mobile (including Google's live PageSpeed mobile test), Google visibility (SEO), trust & security, and lead capture. Returns every problem ranked by impact with a plain-English fix, what already works, and a link to a shareable full report. Use

tools.name: request_help
tools.description: Sends the user's request for help fixing their website to Soofi Digital's team, who will contact them by email or WhatsApp. Only use when the user explicitly asks for help or for Soofi Digital to contact them, and only with contact details the user has given you for this purpose. Confirm the details

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_website · Private data: request_help · Public sink: request_help.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_website · Private data: request_help · Public sink: request_help

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
